about: Gate for run_browser_tests.py. Every tests/browser/browser-groups.json entry runs once and must pass, except the excluded ones. test_gate_rules.py pins these lists (CI runs it): changing them changes what the gate accepts, so docs/hars/BROWSER-TESTS.md and that test change with them.

replay_format2.reason: Not imported into tests/browser: it imports the Python converter's compact.py (compact_data, expand_frames) to build replay format 2 and compares app.js's expansion with it. HARS has no Python converter; the test uses neither the server nor the HARS pages.
replay_format2.replaced_by: Encoder side: integration/pipeline_contract.py (CI, synthetic input) and integration/real_conversion_compare.py (13/14/47 real segments, local) require HARS's whole replayV2 output to equal the Python converter's; scripts/verify_reference.py keeps app.js as preserved. Gap: nothing in HARS runs app.js's format 2 expansion on HARS output.
